svg.title: How a task is accepted
svg.desc: Animated diagram. The T1 worker commits and files fleet_report with the commit, the criteria, the command it ran and its exit code, the tests changed and what it could not establish. mike runs the task's done_when checks at that commit; a failure goes straight back to the worker with a code and no model reads it. The judge reads the diff, the brief and the criteria, not the worker's summary, and may ask the checker one question. A fail names the one thing needed and goes back to the same worker, who reports again. A pass accepts the task and lets waiting tasks start.
svg.text: From a report to an accepted task

g.text: The worker commits and files fleet_report: the commit, the criteria,
the command it ran with its exit, the tests changed, what it could not show.
The floor: mike runs the task's own checks
mike runs done_when at that commit. A failure goes straight back
to the worker with a code, and no model reads the report.
The judge reads the work itself
The judge gets the diff, the brief, the criteria and the report's facts,
At most one question to the checker
When one fact is missing, the judge may ask the checker one narrow
question about one file or output, once.
A fail names the one thing needed
needed: put the Homebrew section above mise. It goes back to
the same worker, which fixes that before anything else.
On the next round the judge asks only whether that one thing is done
and nothing that passed before has broken.
A pass on every criterion it serves accepts T1.
Tasks waiting for it start on mike's next round.
